caption: The drawing depicts a leather belt or sash, primarily black in color, with a white border running along its edges. A section of the belt features a brown leather buckle with metal rivets and fasteners. On the lower section of the belt, there is a red shape that appears to resemble a fire or flame, atop which the word "RESCUE" is inscribed in large white letters. The lettering and the red shape are outlined against the black background of the belt. The entire belt is drawn with shading and texture to show the pliability and material quality of the leather. The composition is against a plain, off-white or light beige background. The drawing is signed "Alfonso Moreno 1938" at the bottom right.
title: Fireman's Life Belt
